generalAbilities.name: Infrared Vision
generalAbilities.description: A bloodbrother can detect infrared radiation (such as that given off by warm-blooded creatures) as a precise sense at the listed range.

defensiveAbilities.name: Frigid Cold
defensiveAbilities.description: 10 feet. A bloodbrother's flesh radiates intense cold. A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Fatigued while it remains in the area. Creatures immune to environmental cold effects or with any cold resistance are immune.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drain Vital Fluids
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements A creature is imprisoned in the bloodbrother's ribcage prison

Effect The bloodbrother drains the vital fluids from the imprisoned creature. The victim is Drained 1 (or increases its drained value by 1), and the bloodbrother regains 10 Healing Damage Hit Points, gaining any excess Hit Points as temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Frigid Touch
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature that begins its turn Grabbed or Restrained by the bloodbrother takes 1d8 Cold Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grisly Ambush
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The bloodbrother hits a creature in the first round of combat, and the bloodbrother was hidden from that creature at the start of combat

Effect Each enemy within 30 feet that witnesses the attack (including the target of the attack) must attempt a DC 25 Will Saving Throw save. On a failure, the creature is Frightened 2 (or Frightened 4 on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Ice Passage
offensiveAbilities.description: A bloodbrother ignores difficult terrain from ice and snow and doesn't risk falling when crossing ice.

offensiveAbilities.name: Imprison
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The bloodbrother has a Large or smaller creature Grabbed or Restrained with their bone spur

Effect The bloodbrother tries to imprison the required creature in their ribcage prison. The bloodbrother attempts an athletics|against:reflex check against the creature's Reflex DC, imprisoning it on a success. The bloodbrother's bone spur is no longer grabbing or restraining the creature they've imprisoned, so the bloodbrother is free to use their bone spur Strike once again. The bloodbrother can't attack a creature they've imprisoned and can have only one creature imprisoned in their ribcage prison at a time. An imprisoned creature is restrained (Escape dc=25) and temporarily immune to the bloodbrother's frigid touch while restrained.
